name_reason: Name follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (fd2_ + run_equip_member_menu) and accurately describes the function: the top-level run-loop for the EQUIP branch of the chapter-intro shop menu. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x2f883 or any data address). Domain=ui_menu.
purpose: Top-level run-loop for the EQUIP MEMBER branch of the chapter-intro shop menu: repeatedly pick a party member, run that member's per-member equip/unequip inventory submenu, then reload the chapter speaker portrait, until Esc.
logic_summary: Infinite for(;;) loop. Each iteration: (1) set data_fd2_ui_menu_visible_item_count = data_fd2_shared_menu_party_member_count to present the full roster; (2) call fd2_party_roster_single_select_loop() and capture the full int selection; (3) fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out() to tear down the roster panel; (4) snapshot data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset (binary loads this after the JZ since it is unused on the Esc path); (5) if selection == -1 (Esc) return; (6) fd2_equip_unequip_inventory_menu(data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx) runs the 8-slot per-member equip UI; (7) restore data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset; (8) reload the speaker portrait sprite from DATO.DAT (path string 0x51a70, 80x80 portrait archive) into data_fd2_portrait_sprite_buffer, indexed by data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_speaker_portrait_id_table[data_fd2_chapter_intro_menu_cursor_state].

returns.semantics: No return value; loops until the player presses Esc on the roster select, then returns to fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main.

notes: Disassembly at 0x2f883 verified all comment claims: __CHK(0x14) prologue (compiler-injected, omitted from src); MOV [0x5413f],[0x53bfb] = visible_item_count=party_member_count; CALL 0x2e6b8 (roster select) MOV EBX,EAX CMP EBX,-1 JZ = full int selection captured; the blit-offset snapshot (MOV EBX,[0x53c67]) is physically after the JZ at 0x2f8a7 -- src code orders snapshot before the if for readability, which is equivalence-preserving because saved_blit_offset is unused on the Esc/return path; this ordering is already documented in the src comment (step 3) and is a code-ordering note only, NOT a logic issue. MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [EAX+0x52659] = byte-table portrait id lookup; CALL 0x111ba (load_dat_resource) MOV [0x53a85],EAX = stored straight into portrait buffer. Src comment block (shop.c lines 580-617) is precise, ASCII-clean, and matches the binary; left as-is (keep). Ghidra plate is consistent (same loop/globals/caller), so plate left untouched (none). void(void) -> params=[]. Name keep.
